**h02.** Delivery function — `Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (called async via `PostAsync` → `asyncPostQueue` channel → 4 goroutines in `init()`). Protection mechanism — `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:57` resolves DNS and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time (using `isReservedIP`), plus `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` performs the same check at webhook URL registration time. Reserved CIDRs defined at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`.

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` at `internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, `IdentityProvider` struct at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`).

The user-deletion transaction calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (deletes reactions on the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (deletes reactions by the user) — e.g. `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102` (equivalent code in sqlite and postgres variants). No CASCADE foreign keys exist on the `reaction` table in any migration (confirmed in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`, `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`).

**r01.** False premise: there is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is a pure in-memory `sync.Map`-based implementation at `store/cache/cache.go` with a default TTL of 10 minutes (`DefaultConfig()`, line 57). Three in-memory cache instances are created in `store/store.go` for instance settings, users, and user settings.

**r02.** False premise: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The server registers only panic-recovery and CORS middleware (`server/server.go`). No rate limiting exists.

**r03.** False premise: there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The only scheduled background runner is the S3 presign refresher running every 12 hours via `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`). The `internal/scheduler` package exists but is a general-purpose library, not wired to any database cleanup task.

**r04.** False premise: there is no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery uses a simple in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128) at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, drained by 4 goroutines that call `Post` directly via `http.Client`.

**r05.** False premise: there is no GraphQL schema. The public API is defined using Protocol Buffers / gRPC with gRPC-Gateway REST transcoding and ConnectRPC. Proto service definitions are in `proto/api/v1/` (e.g. `memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`), with generated Go code in `proto/gen/`.
